Hello, my name is Priya Raman. I am a neurologist from Chennai, in India. I work at a university hospital, and my field is pain medicine. My main focus is nerve pain in patients with diabetes. I have been in this field for about twelve years. This is my third time at this congress, and every year I meet colleagues from countries I have never visited. That is the part I like most. I am here for the workshop on Wednesday, and I hope to hear about new research from South America.

Good morning! Are you Doctor Caitano? I'm Mehmet, from Istanbul. I'm a pharmacologist, like you. I read your abstract last night, the one about leprosy and pain. I have to say, it's not my area, but it was really interesting. We work on chemotherapy and nerve pain, so maybe there is some common ground. Are you presenting today, or tomorrow? I'd like to see your poster, if you have time. And if you're free for lunch, some of us are going to the Thai place across the street.
